user.title: Despensa
user.description: Adds a pantry inventory with its own sidebar panel, a dashboard card, a "Por reponer" (to restock) sensor and voice sentences for Assist. If Cesta is installed, items you mark as bought there are added automatically.

no_cesta.message: Cesta is not installed or not configured.

use_item.name: Use item
use_item.description: Subtracts units of a pantry product and logs it as used.

add_item.name: Add to pantry
add_item.description: Adds units of a product. Creates it on its shelf if it was not in the pantry.

min_stock.name: Minimum stock
min_stock.description: When the stock reaches this number it is flagged.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: How it is counted: cartons, cans, packs…

department.name: Shelf
department.description: Department name or id. Guessed if omitted.

set_stock.name: Set stock
set_stock.description: Corrects how many units there are of a product.

get_items.name: Get pantry
get_items.description: Returns the products with their stock, sorted by shelf, plus a notification-ready text.

low_only.name: Only to restock
low_only.description: Only products at or below their minimum.

add_low_to_cesta.name: Add missing items to Cesta
add_low_to_cesta.description: Adds every product at or below its minimum to the Cesta shopping list.
